storage: Keep in a cool, dry, ventilated spot away from potatoes, for weeks. Cut onion goes in a closed box in the fridge for 2 to 3 days.
looksLike: A round bulb with dry, papery red-brown or pinkish skin and layered white to pale-purple flesh inside. FitPlate dishes use the everyday red onion, not the small sambar onion or spring onion.
howToPick: Firm, heavy bulbs with dry papery skin and no soft spots, sprouting, black mould or a wet neck. Avoid ones that smell sour.
shelfLife: Several weeks in a cool dry airy place (general guidance; not taken from a source in this run).
